description: Land Title Settlement Department - Wayrankattuwa, Arachchikattuwa D/S Division, Puttalam District - Cad. Map No. 410285
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land-related matters, specifically calling for claims to land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It involves land title settlement processes, cadastral maps, and determination of land ownership in specific districts. The content focuses entirely on land registration and title claims, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
